context.person: A person using a smart-home application
context.user_goal: Carry the physical key and replace the batteries promptly.

product_state.preceding_state: A front-door lock reported a battery level too low for reliable remote unlocking.
product_state.current_state: The lock battery is at 4%. The physical key still works.
known_facts: Remote unlocking may stop without warning.
Replacing four AA batteries preserves access codes.

current_content.title: Heads up!
current_content.body: Open the app for more information.

challenge: Rewrite the mobile push notification so the person can understand smart lock battery critically low, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.secondary_action: Dismiss the alert while keeping the warning active.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: Remote unlocking may become unavailable soon.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Carry the physical key and replace the batteries promptly.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
